title: The Cosmic Derelict
summary: "The Cosmic Derelict" by John Broome is a science fiction novel likely written in the early 1940s. As they venture into uncertain territory, the crew must confront both external threats and internal superstitions that challenge their scientific understanding of space travel. As they navigate through the perilous Straits, Douglas and his crew confront both the consequences of superstition and the unyielding nature of scientific principles, ultimately arriving at a greater understanding of their experiences and the importance of empirical knowledge.
